academic_context: Graduate research informed by Thunderbird School of Global Management at Arizona State University
disclaimer: Independent GRI synthesis; no university or faculty endorsement implied. No restricted course texts, exam materials or licensed case reproductions.

records.foundation: Liberalism, economic nationalism and structuralism; institutional incentives, actors, bargaining power and policy choices.
records.application: Compare AI regulation, technology diffusion and mobility-platform governance across institutional environments.
records.attribution: Graduate-level global management synthesis; Nelson's Three Views of the World is a teaching source, not a GRI-authored model.

records.foundation: Risk-adjusted value creation, cash flows, discounting, incentive alignment, scenario analysis and financial uncertainty.
records.application: Evaluate platform economics, algorithmic compensation, productivity claims and who bears operational risk.
records.attribution: Graduate-level financial management synthesis; empirical financial conclusions require case-specific evidence.

records.foundation: Adaptive leadership, responsible management, stakeholder trust, cross-cultural communication and organizational decision-making.
records.application: Assess agentic delegation, human oversight, institutional accountability and adoption risks.
records.attribution: Graduate-level leadership synthesis; not a claim of institutional endorsement.

records.foundation: Political economy, legitimacy, provenance, contestability, accountability and remediation.
records.application: Evaluate evidence integrity, disputed claims, governance safeguards and public-interest outcomes.
records.attribution: Independent GRI analytical extension of global management and institutional governance concepts.

records.foundation: Country context, stakeholder mapping, comparative cases, research questions, documented assumptions and limitations.
records.application: Connect research cases across countries, organizations, AI systems and governance regimes.
records.attribution: General research methodology and graduate study synthesis; no unverified faculty-specific framework attribution.
